title: Geiger Spike vs Background Baseline
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=geiger:cpm
| bin _time span=1h
| stats avg(cpm) as cpm by sensor _time
| eventstats avg(cpm) as baseline_cpm by sensor
| where baseline_cpm>0 AND cpm>baseline_cpm*1.5
| sort - cpm
description: Uses Geiger counter telemetry telemetry to monitor radiation count spikes against the usual background in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sensor events that deserve comparison with public baselines, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Geiger counter telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Hourly chart of CPM versus baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It measures radiation count spikes against the usual background so you can spot sensor events that deserve comparison with public baselines before it becomes annoying.
